description: This file contains the implementation of the Notification controller class for the admin tool section of OpenCart. It defines methods for managing notifications, including listing, viewing details, and deleting notifications within the admin panel.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Controller class for managing notifications in the OpenCart admin panel, extending the system engine controller.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the notification list page in the admin panel.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a JSON response containing a paginated list of notifications.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notifications based on pagination parameters.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns a list of notifications in string format (possibly JSON).

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific notification.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected notifications, provided the user has permission.
